correctness.rationale: For any r≥2, the gradient sequence is surjective. The restriction map is square of dimension 3r. Its middle residual block has determinant (AB)^{r²} times a positive-definite binomial Gram determinant, proving the exact global degree-3r² Cartier divisor by symmetry. Coordinate-line restrictions have one constant syzygy and a second syzygy of coefficient degree 2r, yielding (r,-r); elsewhere the nonzero determinant forces balance. Chern/stability checks and exact computational samples r=1..8 corroborate the proof.
